Challenge C032-CH1: We need to detect unusual behaviour on Modbus and BACnet networks without labelled attack data.
Detail: Our EdgeWatch sensor captures all tr

content.text:
Let me analyze the challenge and researchers quickly.

Core work: Build unsupervised anomaly detection models for Modbus/BACnet traffic sequences (no labelled attack data), deployable on ARM edge sensor with 512MB RAM, within 12 months.

R1008 (Kiss): Exact match - unsupervised anomaly detection, Modbus/DNP3, ICS, lightweight embedded deployment, has testbed, contract research allowed. Publications directly cover this (SYN-PUB-10477, SYN-PUB-10239, SYN-PUB-00492). Can do.

R1015 (Đukić): ICS anomaly detection, intrusion detection, keywords match well. 
Publications include unsupervised Modbus anomaly detection and SCADA IDS work, with joint_project and industrial_phd allowed, but nothing shows edge deployment experience, so this is only a partial fit.

R0071 (Rakić): Strong on anomaly detection, concept drift, and semi-supervised learning, but lacks ICS protocol expertise and prefers labelled data rather than the fully unlabelled setting required here - another partial match.

R0856 (Tadić) focuses on behavioural telemetry and game sequence modelling with no ICS/OT background, so this doesn't fit. R0548 (Stojanović) works in computer vision and visual defect inspection, with no network or ICS security relevance, so this one is also out.
